newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swissair to maintain fuel surcharge.
newsitem.headline: Swissair to maintain fuel surcharge.

text.p: Swiss Cargo, the cargo arm of Swissair, said it would be maintaining a fuel surcharge it applied last autumn.

"When we introduced the surcharge we said we would withdraw it when fuel prices returned to their July 1996 level. While there have been some decreases in the past few months, prices are still above this level," a Zurich-based Swiss Cargo official told Reuters. - Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax:5017
